new: The tutorial's robot guide is never quite still: it breathes, shifts its weight from foot to foot, and its head and hands drift a little.
On a walk it sways side to side, bobs and swings its arms against its steps.
Its turns and its glances ease in and out more softly, with a smaller overshoot.
Everything still follows the story's clock, so jumping and late joiners see the same pose. Rooms stay on format networks-55.
test: In a headset, start Your guide: watch it while it talks to you, and while it walks to the markers in Hello.
In practice mode, use the arrows so it walks between markers: the arms should swing and stop smoothly.
Tell us if the movement is too much or too little.
untested: How it looks at life size in a headset, and whether the feet stay planted during the weight shift (checked here on the page only).
Everything from v136 to v180 that the earlier entries list, except Sharp text, which was tried on a Quest and works.
